decision.recommendation: This is a great behind-the-scenes build moment. 69 failing tests → 0, root-caused a schema drift, fixed in one session. Shows technical depth without leaking architecture. Rephrase in your words.

options.label: Post as text (LinkedIn)
options.description:
DRAFT — rephrase in your voice:

Last night I sat down to run our test suite.
69 failures.

The kind of number that makes you want to close the laptop.

Turns out the database schema had drifted from what the code expected. Missing columns, missing tables — silent rot.

One fix. 315 tests passing. Zero failures.

The lesson: most "impossible" bugs are just one misalignment compounding into chaos. Find the root, everything else resolves.

Building @Chimera in public. More soon.

options.description: Script: Look at camera, casual. "So I ran our test suite last night — 69 failures. Sixty-nine. Wanted to quit. But I dug in, found ONE schema file that was out of sync. Fixed it. 315 tests, all green. That's the thing about building — most problems look massive but they're just one wrong assumption stacked on itself." End with a smirk.
